title: Task List - Task Name filter combines unnamed and named tasks
preconditions: Use a practice whose Task List has at least one task with no Task Name, two tasks with different names, and a task whose name includes an apostrophe. Note the task names and IDs before filtering.
description: Regression coverage for the Task Name filter behavior identified in WMD-1965's investigation and PR #13179. The ticket's written acceptance criterion refers to the Status filter; this case separately verifies the investigated Task Name behavior.

steps.action: Open the Tasks view and clear the Task Name filter.
steps.expected_result: The noted unnamed task and named tasks are present in the unfiltered Task List.

steps.action: In the Task Name filter, select only '(No Task Name)' and apply.
steps.expected_result: Only tasks with no Task Name appear; the noted named tasks are absent.

steps.action: Select '(No Task Name)' together with one noted task name, then apply.
steps.expected_result: Both the unnamed task and the selected named task appear. Tasks with other names are absent.

steps.action: Add the noted name containing an apostrophe to the same filter selection and apply.
steps.expected_result: The unnamed task and both selected named tasks appear without a filter error; tasks with unselected names are absent.

steps.action: Deselect '(No Task Name)' while keeping the two names selected, then apply.
steps.expected_result: Only tasks with the selected names appear; the unnamed task is absent.
The full unfiltered Task List returns.
